public_rationale: Cisco's May 27, 2026 assessment reported successful multi-turn attacks against all 15 tested models, covering OpenAI, Google, Amazon and xAI as well as Anthropic (e1). This supports the claim that jailbreak vulnerability extended beyond Anthropic in the contract's May reporting snapshot, under the evaluation's adversarial test conditions (e1).
limitations: The assessment was published in May, but the accessible source does not give individual experiment dates.
The evidence concerns tested LLMs and attack conditions; it does not establish vulnerability in every generative AI system or deployed application.
Attack success rates in adversarial tests do not measure harmful behavior during ordinary use.
The results do not prove that perfect safeguards are impossible for future systems.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: The inability to block all jailbreaks is a problem with generative AI in general, not one specific to Anthropic.

statement.excerpt: Importantly, this is not an Anthropic problem, it’s a Generative AI problem.
statement.document_title: Breaking: Trump asks the impossible of Anthropic

from_speaker: At least with respect to LLMs
our_interpretation: The plain reading is that vulnerability to jailbreaks extends across developers of general-purpose language models. The surrounding discussion explicitly focuses on LLMs.
Support requires documented successful jailbreaks across multiple non-Anthropic developers. It does not require equal vulnerability across models.
The statement describes an ongoing condition without a reporting period. I use May 2026, the latest complete calendar month before the post, as the reporting snapshot.
This assesses the shared vulnerability of existing systems, not a mathematical claim that every possible future generative system must be vulnerable.
criteria.support_condition: Public adversarial evaluations describing the target period document successful guardrail bypasses in general-purpose language models from at least two non-Anthropic developers.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Broad, credible evaluations establish that the alleged vulnerability was specific to Anthropic and that comparable non-Anthropic systems reliably prevented the relevant bypasses. Failure to find attacks in one bounded test would not establish this.
